🔥 The fire settles. Jesse has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." tableLines.line: ⛓️ Emberhold doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
👁 It is not afraid of you. It has exactly one argument and it wins every argument. Trap it at dusk holding a tarp low — or just don't.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 40s speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
Nikos: "Stinging Nettle is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
✨ Ability gained: Long Table (L1). Share food with everyone in camp to reduce their hunger. Costs 300 kcal; once a day.

⬢ SYSTEM: "One clarification, scholar: linking codices sharpens MY eyes. Ability slots grow from YOUR neural integration — 100/100, holding 6 slots (maxed). Discover, practice, survive — let the interface learn you."
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sofia.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 13,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
A rider says in The Red Table you're "the one who makes deals hold." Nobody remembers when that started being true.
🗣️ Giulia to Liam, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.

With Haven grieving again, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 13,500 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
🚶 Haven walks away from Emberhold's table — a free fire, whatever that costs. The realm continues without you.

🚶 Haven refuses the scale. Every kcal stays in Haven's pantry — no one's court, no one's oath, no pool shares, no tariffs. The price, said plainly: no polity logistics (tribute comes in whole, never ×1.25), no league to call when the late waves come, and the table stays distant. Coalition or death — Haven walks it alone.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 63 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 8 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
The Red Table's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, trade, answered calls is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Emberhold. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
👁 It is not afraid of you. It has exactly one argument and it wins every argument. Trap it at dusk holding a tarp low — or just don't.

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southeast ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Sari's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
